resources.string: A simple distance conversion app for miles, kilometers, and nautical miles.
Convert miles, kilometers, and nautical miles quickly.

Mile Converter is a simple distance conversion app for miles, kilometers, and nautical miles.

Enter a value, choose the source unit, and instantly see converted results for all supported units. The app is designed to be fast, clear, and easy to use for everyday distance conversion.

Features:
- Convert between miles, kilometers, and nautical miles
- Choose any supported unit as the input unit
- Copy converted values
- Works fully offline
- No account required
- No ads
- No tracking
- No special permissions

Mile Converter performs all calculations locally on your device. It does not collect personal data, use analytics, show ads, or make network requests.
Enter a value and choose the source unit.
Enter a valid number to see conversions.
